name: The Great War
description: June 1914: the alliance blocs of Europe stand armed and wary, while colonial empires span the globe. One shot in Sarajevo could set the whole system alight.
approximations: Borders follow modern admin-1 provinces, so each province goes to whoever held most of it in mid-1914 (e.g. Alsace-Lorraine as the Moselle province, Galicia, Bukovina and Transylvania, Western Thrace given to Bulgaria, Dodecanese to Italy, south Sakhalin left with Russia, Kuwait, Qatar and the Trucial States folded into British holdings). Population (millions) and GDP (billions of 1990 international dollars) are rounded Maddison-style estimates that include colonies; army sizes are rounded peacetime strengths; Arabian emirates, Tibet and Mongolia are given their de facto extents. Svalbard and Bouvet Island are left unowned (terra nullius in 1914).
